_doc: FROZEN, APPEND-ONLY. Do not edit an existing entry — not on rename, not ever.
Appending an entry for a NEW record is the only permitted mutation.
`ids` maps each recipe's permanent id to the name it was assigned AGAINST.
That name is also the localStorage key users held before the id migration, so
rewriting one to a recipe's current name would make the migration look up a key
nobody has and silently orphan that record's saved state.
When a recipe is renamed, its `ids` entry STAYS as-is and its id is added to
`renamed` (id -> short note). That is what keeps the integrity test passing:
the exception is recorded here as evidence, never by relaxing the test.
When a recipe is REMOVED, its `ids` entry STAYS as-is and its id is added to
plus an optional "versions": N when the removed record displayed as N versions.
Old links, `?recipe=` keys and saved state then resolve to the successor; with
`to: null` they resolve to nothing. `to` must name a live record, never another
removed one. Remove the record, add it here and decrement EXPECTED_RECORDS in
src/data/recordCount.js, all in the same commit.
